args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed and began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an elevated error rate (~18%). SRE rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all production regions. Post-rollback verification shows the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with a healthy production status. The rollback has completed in all three regions, and post-rollback verification shows the service is **healthy** with an error rate of ~0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failure and rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures has not been identified — the incident remains open for investigation by the on-call engineer.
